spans.s: बाण m. 1. An arrow, a shaft, R.xii.50; 2. an aim; 3. the udder of a cow; 4. the feathered end of an arrow; 5. a kind of creeper (नीलझिंटी), विकचबाणदलावलयोऽधिकं रुरुचिरे रुचिरेक्षणविभ्रमाः Sis.vi.46; 6. name of a demon, son of Virochana; 7. name of a celebrated poet, the author of Kādambarī, Harshacharita and many other works, who flourished between 600 and 650 A.D., जाता शिखंडिनी प्राग्यथा शिखंडी तथावगच्छामि । प्रागल्भ्यमधिकमाप्तुं वाणी बाणो बभूवेति Govardhana; 8. the number ‘five.’
बाण-असन n. a bow.
बाण-आवलि, -आवली f. 1. a series of arrows; 2. a series of five stanzas forming one sentence.
बाण-आवलि, -आवली f. 1. a series of arrows; 2. a series of five stanzas forming one sentence.
बाण-आश्रय m. quiver.
बाण-गोचर m. the range of an arrow.
बाण-जाल n. a number or multitude of arrows.
बाण-जित् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
बाण-तूण, -धि m. a quiver.
बाण-तूण, -धि m. a quiver.
बाण-पथ m. the range of an arrow.
बाण-पाणि a. armed with arrows.
बाण-पात m. 1. an arrow-shot; 2. the range of an arrow.
बाण-पुंखा f. the feathered end of an arrow.
बाण-मुक्ति f. discharging an arrow.
बाण-मोक्षण n. discharging an arrow.
बाण-योजन n. a quiver.
बाण-वृष्टि f. a shower of arrows.
बाण-वार m. a breast-plate, an armour. Cf. वारबाण.
बाण-सुता f. an epithet of Ushā, daughter of the demon Bāṇa.
बाण-हन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
बाणिनी f. 1. An excellent woman; 2. a shrewd woman; 3. a dancing girl; 4. a drunken woman, यस्मिन्महीं शासति बाणिनीं निद्रां विहारार्धपथे गतानाम् R.vi.75.
